## Members-only wings + Profile dashboard

- **Labs, Exchange, Codex are now token-holder-only.** A visitor who isn't signed in sees a "Members Only" gate with a Sign in with Google button. A signed-in visitor who doesn't own any tokens sees a friendly gate that offers the $5 Access Token on the Storefront and a paste-a-code box to link a code they already own. Actual members see the page with a small gold strip on top showing their live token count and a link to their Profile.
- **New /profile page.** Shows your Google identity + Sign Out, your Token Wallet (per-code balance and status), a Purchase History table (all Gumroad sales tied to your email — token packs and consultations), a Consultation History list, and an Activity list (courses you unlocked, tokens you spent on the Exchange).
- **How access is decided**: you're a "member" if your Google email is on any Gumroad sale OR you've linked any redemption code — even zero-balance codes still count so paying customers who used up their tokens keep their history.
- **Tested end-to-end**: full pytest suite passing 17/17 (including idempotency on link-code, expired-session rejection, and zero-balance still-a-member); Playwright covered guest / outsider / member states on Exchange + Codex, the static Labs gate (both redirect and reveal), and the Profile page in both signed-out and member modes.

Please open the app and: 1) visit `/exchange` while signed out (should show Members Only), 2) tap Sign in in the header, sign in with any Google account, then visit `/profile` (should show your identity and empty wallet), 3) paste a valid redemption code on the Exchange gate to link it, then reload — the Exchange should open with the member strip up top. **Tap Publish in Emergent to make this live on nextxus.help** — I can't deploy for you.
